research-bot.name: Research Bot
research-bot.description: Summarizes documents and answers research queries

customer-research-agent.name: Customer Research Agent
customer-research-agent.description: Handles customer inquiry analysis, trend detection, and generates insights from support tickets and feedback data for the operations team
customer-research-agent.context: his agent processes customer support tickets, feedback forms, and chat transcripts to identify recurring issues and sentiment trends. It has read-only access to the customer database and can generate summary reports. It must never share customer PII with external APIs, never modify production databases, and always route escalated complaints to a human agent. Approved behaviors: read tickets, aggregate metrics, generate CSV exports. Restricted: no financial data access, no account modifications.
